correctness.rationale: RESULT.md steps 1-5 parameterize x=a cosh u, y=b sinh u as z=cw+conj(c)/w, w>0. The deck involutions w->r/w and w->conj(r)/w imply invariance by rotation r^2. Infinite rotation order forces a constant rational function by finite generic fibers; finite order m=q/gcd(q,2) yields fixed field C(w^m+epsilon/w^m), equal to rational functions of a real-valued Dickson T_m(z). Degree of rational maps composes multiplicatively, giving first ambiguity at m with T_m±i. Multiplying |P(z(w))|²-|Q(z(w))|² by w^(2n) yields polynomial degree <=4n, proving any 4n+1 distinct samples suffice for n<m. The zero-polynomial case and quotient poles on the real branch are separately addressed. Independent SymPy rederived T_2=-i(z²-1) and exact identical moduli for a=b=1.
